neighbours.label: ' as' straight after 'so': 'so as not to', 'So as I said'
fire: She closed the door softly, so as not to wake the baby.
So as you can see, it works.
So as of today, the shop is closed.
He stayed quiet so as not to annoy them.
So as part of the plan, we cut costs.
They moved slowly so as to avoid the guards.
So as I said, the test failed.
We left early so as to catch the train.
quiet: She closed the door softly, so the baby slept.
As you can see, it works.
So far today, the shop is closed.
He stayed quiet and did not annoy them.
As part of the plan, we cut costs.
They moved slowly to avoid the guards.
So I said the test failed.
We left early to catch the train.

notes: Corpus max is tiny (0.13), and near misses can read negative. The neuron's - pole is flagged dense on the card; this + pole is not.
